name: nz-legislation-mcp
description: Search and read New Zealand legislation via the official PCO Legislation API.
long_description: Unofficial, security-hardened MCP server for the New Zealand Legislation API. Bring your own API key. Unofficial: not affiliated with the Parliamentary Counsel Office. Check the official version on legislation.govt.nz.

tools.name: search_legislation
tools.description: Search New Zealand Acts, Bills, secondary legislation (regulations, orders, rules, etc.) and amendment papers on legislation.govt.nz.

tools.name: get_legislation
tools.description: Get metadata and links for one version of a piece of NZ legislation.

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: List the versions of one work (e.g. an Act as at each amendment date), newest first by default.

tools.name: get_table_of_contents
tools.description: List the structure of a version of NZ legislation: parts, subparts, cross-headings, sections and schedules, with labels to pass to get_provision_text.

tools.name: get_provision_text
tools.description: Get the text of one section, a clause in a schedule, or a whole schedule, from the official XML.

tools.name: compare_versions
tools.description: Show what changed in one section, schedule clause or schedule between two versions of a work, as a line diff.

tools.name: get_api_quota
tools.description: Show how many Legislation API requests remain today for this API key (10,000 per day by default, resetting at midnight NZ time).

api_key.title: Legislation API key
api_key.description: Your own API key for api.legislation.govt.nz (request one by email to contact@pco.govt.nz; see https://www.legislation.govt.nz/developer-api/). It is sent only to that API.
